mapper.insert: insert into basket_team_audit_record (team_id, audit_type, audit_action, before_status, after_status, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{teamId}, #{auditType}, #{auditAction}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{auditorId}, #{auditorName}, #{auditRemark}, #{auditTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select id, team_id, audit_type, audit_action, before_status, after_status, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_team_audit_record where team_id = #{teamId} and is_delete = 0 order by audit_time desc
